resources.string: APK backup and restore with honest privilege tiers.
Archives are .kilnbackup.zip with metadata.json. Optional AES-GCM password encryption is available. Private /data/data is not included without Root.
No Shizuku: APK-only archives. Restore installs every APK in the archive (base + splits) via PackageInstaller (system confirm) or silent install when Shizuku is ready.
Shizuku is ready: backups can include Android/data and OBB for the selected package when those folders exist. Root /data/data remains deferred.
Root capability seen, but Kiln still does not package /data/data. Shizuku Android/data + OBB apply when that capability is available.
No folder selected — Backup will ask where to save each file.
Restore queued — confirm the system install dialog if shown; shared data restores when Shizuku can write Android/data

Kiln extracts every APK in the archive (base + splits) and queues a multi-session install. When the archive includes Android/data or OBB and Shizuku is available, Kiln also restores those folders after the package is present (current-user paths). A system confirm may appear.
Archive claims splits but only one APK was found — restore aborted so a broken install is not queued.
This device has more than one Android user. Pick which user the silent restore install should target. Android/data and OBB still use current-user paths.
This device has more than one Android user. Tag which user this backup is intended for. APK bytes are package-wide; Android/data and OBB still use current-user paths.
Could not open the selected file
Choose a backup folder first, or clear encryption and use the file picker
Could not create a file in the backup folder
